package fixture

// A shaping helper that decides access. The name says what it is, whatever the body does — and in
// the BFF there is no correct version of this: ask the PDP through internal/pep.
type viewer struct{ roles []string }

func hasPermission(v viewer, action string) bool {
	for _, r := range v.roles {
		if r == action {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
